items.title: Edgar "Sambo" Joseph Interview, 1960-08-07
items.q: I even got with Schatz... So, one Sunday Schatz called me up and said, I got to pray... I went just the same... I done one of them... I get there. Man, I had, boy, you making a whole lot of noise.

ctx.x: Can you remember who else was studying with you at that time?

Gilbert Young was going there too. You know Gilbert Young? Yeah. Wake up at the post office. Gilbert used to be the worst one in the bunch. Oh, man, I had trouble with Gilbert. See, his son Gilbert would take lessons. You know what he'd do, Bill? Gilbert would spend his money. That time Gilbert was living on, yeah. Gilbert used to be, you know like all kids. Gilbert would go to the show. I ain't lie, I would go to the show too. I went to the show too. Take the horn, go in the show. Come back, go, yeah, I went to…
